description: This file contains implementation for handling patch identifiers in a Git-like version control system, including functions for computing, comparing, and managing patch IDs associated with commits.

methods.name: int patch_id_defined(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Checks if the commit has 0 or 1 parents, which is valid for patch ID computation.

methods.name: int commit_patch_id(struct commit * commit,struct diff_options * options,struct object_id * oid,int diff_header_only)
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given commit based on its diff with its parent or root.

methods.name: int patch_id_neq(const void * cmpfn_data,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs for equality or difference, computing patch IDs if necessary.

methods.name: int init_patch_ids(struct repository * r,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Initializes the patch_ids structure for a repository, setting up diff options and internal hashmap.

methods.name: int free_patch_ids(struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the patch_ids structure.

methods.name: int init_patch_id_entry(struct patch_id * patch,struct commit * commit,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Initializes a patch_id entry with commit data and computes its header-only patch ID.

methods.name: struct:patch_id * patch_id_iter_first(struct commit * commit,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Returns the first patch_id associated with a commit, used for iteration.

methods.name: struct:patch_id * patch_id_iter_next(struct patch_id * cur,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Returns the next patch_id in the iteration.

methods.name: int has_commit_patch_id(struct commit * commit,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Checks if a commit has an associated patch ID.

methods.name: struct:patch_id * add_commit_patch_id(struct commit * commit,struct patch_ids * ids)
methods.description: Adds a patch ID for a commit into the patch_ids structure.

ctags.name: commit_patch_id
ctags.signature: (struct commit * commit,struct diff_options * options,struct object_id * oid,int diff_header_only)

ctags.name: init_patch_id_entry
ctags.signature: (struct patch_id * patch,struct commit * commit,struct patch_ids * ids)

ctags.name: patch_id_neq
ctags.signature: (const void * cmpfn_data,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
